summary:
ASTRA – Astronaut Health Monitoring System

Project Summary

ASTRA (Astronaut Health Monitoring System) is a Python-based software application designed to demonstrate how astronaut health and spacecraft environmental conditions can be monitored during space missions.

The system provides a centralized mission monitoring dashboard that displays important astronaut health parameters, including heart rate, blood oxygen level, body temperature and blood pressure. It also includes health analytics, automated monitoring, emergency alerts and health status classification.
The application includes an astronaut profile system, SQLite database for storing health records, graphical analytics, and downloadable CSV and PDF reports.

Technologies Used: Python, Streamlit, Pandas, SQLite and Matplotlib-free Streamlit charts.

Key Features:

- Astronaut health monitoring and analytics
- Emergency alert and response system
- Automatic health data refresh
- Spacecraft environment monitoring
- Oxygen, water, food and battery management
- Resource consumption prediction
- Mission risk assessment
- Mission decision support dashboard
- Health record storage and report generation

Project Goal: To develop an integrated demonstration platform that brings astronaut health monitoring, environmental awareness and mission resource management together in one application.
details:
ASTRA – Astronaut Health Monitoring System

ASTRA is a Python-based astronaut health monitoring application developed using Streamlit. It is designed to demonstrate how astronaut health and mission conditions can be monitored during space missions.

The system simulates important health parameters such as heart rate, blood oxygen level, body temperature, and blood pressure. It provides health analytics, health status classification, emergency alerts, and mission control recommendations.

ASTRA also includes space environment monitoring, resource management, resource prediction, mission risk assessment, and decision support features. It uses SQLite to store health records and supports CSV and PDF report generation.

The project aims to demonstrate how an integrated digital monitoring platform can support astronaut health awareness and mission management.

Note: This prototype uses simulated readings for demonstration and educational purposes. It is not a certified medical or flight-safety system.
